baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb at word 1 and the reciprocal participle at word 5 bind dress to social orientation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fine material closes around each body while reciprocal facing opens every covered body toward others; private enclosure and public availability operate at different scales.

activation_trace.role: Covering by something worn supplies the enclosing material layer around each person.
One thing facing another supplies the reciprocal geometry that opens the clothed persons toward one another.

changed_reading.before: A list of luxurious clothes followed by a seating posture.
changed_reading.after: One coordinated scene in which bodily enclosure and social openness coexist.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Wearing and mutual facing occur in one compact predication, and the named materials are woven textiles.
baseline_models.mechanism: Intimate association activates the wearing verb beyond surface dress, while mutually opposed joined parts make the group resemble a fabric whose distinct pieces hold by facing contact.

activation_trace.role: Close mingling and companionship make dress a figure for sustained social contact.
Joined sections set against one another provide the textile-like construction of the assembled group.

changed_reading.before: Individuals happen to wear the same class of fabric near one another.
changed_reading.after: Their face-to-face association is itself textile-like: distinct persons joined without being collapsed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reciprocal form at word 5 can carry more relational force than a mere direction of chairs.
baseline_models.mechanism: Close association plus pleased acceptance turns mutual facing into reciprocal reception; the scene describes a community in which each person is available to, and welcomed by, another.

activation_trace.role: Intimate association gives the garments an interpersonal rather than merely decorative register.
Receiving with approval changes facing from bare sightline into mutual welcome.
A group whose members turn toward one another supplies the communal scale of that welcome.

changed_reading.before: They occupy a symmetrical visual arrangement.
changed_reading.after: They actively receive one another in a mutually consenting social arrangement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same wearing root admits protective armor, while the facing root admits capacity to withstand.
baseline_models.mechanism: Silk replaces hard armor without losing the semantic possibility of protection; mutual facing is possible because threat no longer dictates defensive posture.

activation_trace.role: Armor worn for defense lets the fine garments retain a transformed protective function.
Capacity to face and withstand supplies the latent condition that has become effortless here.

changed_reading.before: Silk advertises luxury after danger has ended.
changed_reading.after: Silk is disarmed armor: safety has become soft enough to wear without vigilance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 can evoke obscuring mixture, but word 5 places every person visibly before another.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause holds concealment and exposure together: covering no longer enables evasive ambiguity because reciprocal facing removes the hidden back.

activation_trace.role: Confusing mixture supplies the risk that an outer layer might obscure identity or condition.
Direct mutual facing counters obscurity with exposed, reciprocal presence.

changed_reading.before: Dress covers and facing merely locates.
changed_reading.after: Covering is retained, but its power to disguise is neutralized by mutual visibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated disclosure and differentiation run against recurrent doubt. They revise the focus tension between ambiguous covering and direct facing: clothing now marks a condition that cannot be confused, while the group remains openly legible to itself.

activation_trace.role: Confusing mixture supplies the focus problem of a covering that could obscure distinctions.
Direct mutual facing supplies the focus means of visible exposure.
Emergence into visibility establishes disclosure as an opening movement of the surah.
Distinguishing one thing from another supplies the operation that makes states non-interchangeable.
Two possibilities interpenetrating without certainty names the earlier unstable condition being reversed.
Doubt and hesitation immediately before the secure scene sharpen its arrival as resolved legibility.

structural_cues: Forms of mubin recur before the focus, while tamtarun closes the punishment tableau three ayat before it.
The focus places material covering and reciprocal exposure in the same clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, differentiation, doubt, and a focus pair of covering/facing; I infer a reversal from confused appearance to embodied legibility. A live alternative is that the garments only identify reward and the facing is spatial.

changed_reading.before: The wearing root leaves a live undertone of disguise or confused mixture.
changed_reading.after: The garments become visible differentiation rather than disguise, and mutual facing confirms a state no longer open to doubt.

context_deltas.mechanism: An imposed covering first blankets people as affliction and is briefly lifted; later gardens, garments, security, and explicit warding form a nested counter-cover. The fine clothing is not only reward but the tactile face of having danger kept outside.

activation_trace.role: A covering worn on the body supplies the innermost benign layer of enclosure.
Protective armor lets softness retain the function of defense after violence disappears.
A blanket-like affliction covering everyone supplies the destructive counterpart to being clothed.
Lifting a cover establishes removal of affliction as a distinct but temporary operation.
Settled security supplies the affective state embodied by the soft covering.
A protecting shield activates the gardens as an outer shelter around the clothed bodies.
Blazing heat specifies the external threat from which the soft enclosure is separated.
Warding off harm explicitly supplies the protective arrow that the garment alone only suggested.

structural_cues: The focus is nested between secure station and gardens before it and explicit protection from hell after it.
The earlier smoke covers people; the later clothing covers the protected.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harmful covering, lifted covering, secure gardens, blazing threat, and explicit warding; I infer that the clothing materializes the resulting boundary of safety. It may instead be a co-present gift with no protective function of its own.

changed_reading.before: Fine cloth is ornamental luxury after safety has already been achieved.
changed_reading.after: Fine cloth is transformed armor within nested shelter, making safety bodily perceptible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal gathering is followed by the collapse of patron-to-patron benefit and help, with mercy as the exception. Mutual facing then figures a community of reciprocal presence rather than a hierarchy of rescuers and dependents.

activation_trace.role: Close association makes the focus scene answer a prior crisis in social relation.
Standing surety activates the question of who can answer for another without making the blessed causal saviors.
A mutually oriented group supplies the replacement social form after patronage fails.
A gathered multitude establishes the universal social field that will be sorted into different relations.
Affection, alliance, and support supply the bond whose capacity to avail is explicitly denied there.
Aid and vindication identify the failed rescue function, preventing mutual facing from being read as self-salvation.
Merciful tenderness supplies the actual exception under which reciprocal presence becomes possible.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from all gathered, to no patron availing another, to mercy, then to the secure face-to-face group.
The reciprocal participle avoids a single privileged human center.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed patronal aid, mercy, and mutual orientation; I infer a shift from vertical dependency to horizontal presence under mercy, not that the inhabitants save one another. The alternative is ordinary convivial seating unrelated to 44:41.

changed_reading.before: Mutual facing expresses sociability among rewarded individuals.
changed_reading.after: It is a non-patronal social order: no human is another's absent rescuer, yet none turns away from another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier regime leaves gardens, springs, a noble station, and soft luxury to others after its arrogant height collapses. Their recurrence around 44:53 makes silk and facing a reconfiguration of luxury: possession is no longer staged as elevation over subjects but as shared, peer-visible habitation.

activation_trace.role: Worn covering makes inherited or granted luxury bodily present rather than merely environmental.
Mutual facing supplies a horizontal geometry opposed to solitary elevation.
A group oriented member-to-member turns privilege into a shared social condition.
Tree-covered gardens provide the first occurrence of the setting later repeated beside the focus.
Flowing springs complete the repeated environmental pair that links lost and granted luxury.
Residence in a station supplies the earlier noble habitation echoed by the later secure station.
Softness and ease of life provide the material register in which the silk participates.
Bestowal without bargain supplies the transfer mechanism that detaches luxury from its former holders.
Arrogant elevation names the failed geometry against which reciprocal facing reads differently.

structural_cues: Gardens and springs recur verbatim in 44:25 and 44:52; maqam karim in 44:26 becomes maqam amin in 44:51.
The earlier possessors leave their luxury, whereas the focus group is described by reciprocal orientation rather than a ruler's elevation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical recurrence, dispossession, bestowal, and arrogant height; I infer that the second luxury tableau deliberately changes the social geometry of abundance. The recurrence may instead contrast outcomes without critiquing hierarchy inside the focus scene.

changed_reading.before: Silk and gardens are generic emblems of high status.
changed_reading.after: They are abundance detached from domination and re-housed in a face-to-face collective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The condemned body is seized, dragged toward a center, and subjected from above before being ordered to experience the result. The focus reverses every vector: bodies are softly covered, remain agents of wearing, and orient symmetrically toward peers.

activation_trace.role: Self-borne covering replaces externally imposed contact with the body.
Reciprocal facing supplies a horizontal and symmetric bodily vector.
Capture and seizure remove bodily agency at the opening of the punishment movement.
Violent dragging by force supplies the imposed horizontal trajectory being reversed.
Directed movement toward a destination fixes the coerced body's single target.
Pouring down supplies invasive contact imposed from outside the body.
Dominating height supplies the vertical asymmetry absent from mutual facing.
The head as bodily top locates where vertical domination lands.
Forced experiential knowledge completes the loss of agency before the focus tableau reverses it.

structural_cues: Imperatives dominate 44:47-49; the focus returns to a finite verb whose subjects perform their own action and a reciprocal participle.
Dragged toward one center and poured on from above contrasts with many persons facing one another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coercive motion, vertical domination, bodily experience, and then reciprocal posture; I infer a designed spatial reversal restoring agency and symmetry. The alternative is juxtaposition of punishments and rewards without vector-level correspondence.

changed_reading.before: Mutual facing is a static arrangement chosen for conviviality.
changed_reading.after: It is restored bodily agency: no one is dragged, pinned beneath an above, or reduced to another's target.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediate pairing and the marked eye-field after the focus strengthen the acceptance branch of facing. The group tableau can include intimate dyads of reciprocal gaze without collapsing into either only communal seating or only pairing.

activation_trace.role: Close companionship gives the wearing verb an intimate relational resonance.
Receiving with pleasure lets mutual facing become reciprocal recognition and welcome.
Joining one companion to another supplies a dyadic relation immediately after the communal orientation.
Strong ocular contrast foregrounds eyes as the perceptual site of face-to-face recognition.
The seeing eye makes gaze a live mechanism rather than an inferred abstraction alone.

structural_cues: The pairing clause follows immediately with kadhalik, tying it to the established scene.
The plural communal arrangement can contain, rather than exclude, paired relations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mutual facing, pairing, and two eye-marking roots; I infer reciprocal recognition as their shared mechanism. A live alternative is that mutaqabilin governs the larger gathering while pairing is a separate subsequent gift.

changed_reading.before: The inhabitants look across a communal space.
changed_reading.after: Their orientation also permits intimate reciprocal recognition: being paired does not turn either person away from the wider group.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah turns speech into effortless provision: they call, every fruit is available, and fear is absent. The receiving branch of facing therefore becomes logistical as well as affective; an open circle can receive and circulate abundance without competition.

activation_trace.role: Receiving what arrives into the hand supplies the focus group's receptive posture.
Provision brought to mouths adds a concrete hospitality register to mutual orientation.
Calling and drawing something near supplies the initiating movement of provision.
Comprehensive totality removes scarcity from the receiving mechanism.
Pleasant fruit supplies the concrete object received and shared in the scene.
Heart-settling security removes defensive competition from the act of receiving.

structural_cues: The subject remains plural from wearing and facing into calling, so posture and provision form one continuous social scene.
Every fruit and security pair plenitude with absence of threat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a receiving branch, plural calling, total fruit, and security; I infer an open hospitality circuit rather than individual consumption. The alternative is simple service to separately seated recipients.

changed_reading.before: Facing supports conversation while luxury is privately consumed.
changed_reading.after: Facing is also a receptive economy in which abundance arrives openly and without rivalry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier denial of being raised is answered by a scene after the first death in which further death is warded off. The fresh-beginning branch of facing makes mutaqabilin temporal as well as spatial: they inhabit an unprepared new present that does not close again.

activation_trace.role: A fresh beginning not rehearsed in advance lets the posture mark arrival into a genuinely new mode of time.
Coming ahead or a next stage adds temporal motion to the reciprocal spatial form.
Reviving the dead supplies the transition whose denial earlier made the focus scene impossible.
Loss of life is confined to the named first occurrence, defining what the new present excludes.
Beginning and priority bound death to a first event rather than an endlessly repeatable horizon.
Warding harm gives the new temporal condition continuity instead of another terminal reversal.

structural_cues: The denial in 44:35 uses the passive plural of rising; 44:56 restricts death to the first death.
The focus reciprocal form sits between the secure setting and the explicit end of repeated death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied resurrection, first death, warding, and a branch of fresh inception; I infer that facing registers arrival into a deathless present. The live alternative is that its force remains wholly spatial and chronology belongs only to 44:56.

changed_reading.before: They are settled in a completed reward tableau.
changed_reading.after: They are continually at the fresh face of a life whose only death is already behind them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it makes textile, social assembly, and discourse share one construction; it remains anchored in wearing woven materials and the focus branch of joined facing parts, while the packet independently supplies joined writing, tightly woven truth, articulated segments, and language. Render it as a material analogy activated by the surah's diction, not as a claim that the garments literally encode text.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The silk-wearing clause immediately couples woven matter with a participle whose branch inventory includes joined parts facing each other.

activation_trace.role: A worn covering supplies the literal textile surface on which the analogy remains anchored.
Joined sections facing one another supply a seam-like model for the assembled persons.
Joining one thing to another supplies the constructive operation shared by writing and weaving.
Ordered letters provide the discourse domain from which the social-textile analogy crosses.
Tight construction in either weaving or speech explicitly bridges the packet's material and verbal domains.
Segments that regulate discourse supply distinct units held within an ordered whole.
Language and speech return the constructed scene to communicable articulation at the surah's close.

changed_reading.before: The scene contains textiles and people as unrelated categories of object.
changed_reading.after: The people form a readable social weave: articulated, distinct, and joined face-to-face like ordered material or speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The charm-bead branch is culturally specific and form-distant, so treating it as literal magic would overreach. It remains worth carrying because it is anchored directly in mutaqabilin, whose rare branch imagines an object turning one face toward another, and the next ayah supplies pairing. Render only the stripped analogy of attraction or reorientation: alienation has lost its hold and faces are drawn back into relation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reciprocal facing at word 5 is the exact bodily result imagined by the distant branch, while wearing supplies an adjacent object-bearing domain.

activation_trace.role: A bead imagined to turn one face toward another supplies the strange agency-bearing analogy for restored relation.
Something borne on the body keeps the object analogy adjacent to the literal focus scene.
Making one thing companion to another supplies a nearby relational outcome that contains the distant activation.

changed_reading.before: The inhabitants independently choose to look toward one another.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the scene figures an environment whose very gifts draw estranged faces back into relation.

strongest_changes: Silk changes from ornament into a benign counter-cover and transformed armor within explicit protection.
Mutual facing changes from static seating into the bodily reversal of seizure, dragging, and vertical domination.
Repeated gardens and stations change luxury from an emblem of arrogant elevation into shared face-to-face habitation.
The ambiguity branch of wearing is not discarded: disclosure, differentiation, and resolved doubt turn covering into legible distinction.
Failed patronage followed by mercy changes the group from a hierarchy of rescuers into reciprocal presence under protection none of them causes.
summary.what_was_special: The focus clause repeatedly worked as a hinge rather than a catalog: covering could protect without hiding, facing could expose without threatening, soft cloth could retain armor's function, and private delight could become social structure. Distant branches also activated a social textile, a receptive economy, a fresh post-death present, and a carefully contained face-turning analogy without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet strongly supports contrasts of cover, safety, and bodily direction, but the claim that the garment itself materializes protection remains a reader-supplied arrow.
Acceptance, surety, receiving, fresh beginning, and joined-part senses of ق ب ل may be analogical activations around the reciprocal form rather than simultaneous lexical force.
The repeated luxury vocabulary clearly links the two tableaux; whether it specifically revises political hierarchy or only contrasts outcomes remains open.
Pairing and eye vocabulary may deepen mutual recognition, or may begin a distinct gift after the communal facing scene.
